summary:
Review a finite delegated sequence once against exact source, input identities, output paths, resources, ordered actions and original absolute deadlines. Let the owner advance through that complete sequence without another coordinator approval after each success. Stop at the first failure, uncertainty or determining-input change; retain original results and perform only the selected cleanup. Independent step clocks stay inside the parent clock. No automatic retry, renewed allowance, success relabeling or recovery search follows. Ordinary isolated verification and bounded read-only Home diagnostics already have standing authorization; actual configuration changes still follow their reviewed operation.

Conditionally produced inputs may feed later steps only through closed verified derivations: review the exact derivation and source/input set, then check the resulting actual identity and original deadline before the next step; an unreviewed discovered input cannot extend the envelope.

Isolation must cover engine storage, runtime state, outputs, namespaces and process containment, not only operation names. ADR0096 permits fresh work when its actual boundary is independent of retained historical Unknowns. Preserve old births, missing facts and failed outcomes; block new work when their interference is relevant. Prove disjoint paths/units/namespaces and current resource/backing fit. An unrecoverable historical hold is neither cleared by new success nor a blanket ban on unrelated isolated work.

Two Home GitHub source envelopes completed with one canonical apply each and independent cold readback inside their original limits, in approximately150 and42seconds. The later accepted FourD51 source sequence used the same pattern: https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6404209641. These demonstrate reduced approval churn; token savings are unmeasured. Endpoint-specific credential capability matters: Home's existing OAuth/keyring route supplied private Checks unavailable to Root's credential. A403 is unavailable evidence, not empty policy or grounds to create another token/App. The private-bootstrap-capability-boundary record retains that separate contract.

The accepted native initialization/old-remnant sequence at https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6400467943 completed in237.834seconds inside one900-second ceiling with separate unchanged300-second step clocks and no intermediate approval/retry. Fresh initialization supplied actual namespace/guard/fence and two collections; eight captured actors retired independently. Exact old-remnant cleanup used three individual stops, three authenticated file removals and reload. This qualified initialization/retirement only, not an image, export, bake, registration or consumer. The reservation was an operator envelope, not a fabricated new hard parent cgroup.

Typed observations and property applicability are essential. An already-collected scope must not make a batched stop skip still-owned units. An unconfigured/not-found service need not render a command property that only the configured guard has. Preserve actual missing/Unknown fields; do not synthesize defaults. Stop-RPC success, service/finalizer outcome, current process absence and original-birth retirement are separate facts. The old guard's stop-post exit3 remains failed even after files/groups are gone. Constructor fixtures, callback tuples or internal collections do not establish whole retirement. Validate producer records against actual production readers before native use; reports need captured birth/boot/cgroup and physical outside evidence.

Prepare and freeze the complete caller/source/input set before the operational clock. Root entry gates must enforce absolute starts before reading queued payloads; repeated short I/O limits cannot renew the original. An expired or uncertain send is never resent. Retain partial stdout/stderr/backing on failure and reserve time for collection, authenticated cleanup and independent outside observation. Original failure and later cleanup success remain distinct.

Root accepted the empty physical journal lifecycle at https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6404664301: one actual128MiB/16384-inode tmpfs, three same-filesystem aliases, one10240-byte archive of three empty domains, reverse nonlazy unbind and original filesystem retirement. Both Root actors, ordinary caller and observer were waited/independently gone within the same900-second original; outside completion took2.329959134seconds. A subsequent same-original cold read found all four exact paths/mountpoints absent. This proves that empty lifecycle and byte custody only: no deliberate exhaustion/deleted-open workload test, engine, export, VM/bake, registration or consumer was qualified. Historical mount IDs cannot be reused as ownership.

Before that run, a metadata reader refused on a field-name mismatch before any operational original/command/kernel effect. Its corrected bounded diagnostic retained the failure and confirmed the same unused selection, capacity, operator and applicable Root umask. Standing authorization allowed the read repair; no host setting changed and no native retry/new original followed. Reservations, virtual-address limits, inherited cgroups and hard filesystem quotas remain different observations. Private raw evidence and runtime assets stay outside Atlas. Refresh determining source, capability, capacity and ownership before each actual selection; a record or source snapshot grants no operation.

Manual-channel pickup and actual execution clocks are separate. At https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6405577166 Home reported semantic review after an overly short pickup deadline, despite successful fetches. The selection expired UNUSED: no original/controller/preflight/apply began. Root retained that fact and issued a fresh exact selection with a realistic pickup window; it did not revive the expired selection or renew an execution allowance. A fetched message is not acknowledgment or continuous monitoring. Size pickup windows for the actual channel and stage source before minting the finite original; preserve every phase clock and first failure once it starts.
title: Finite delegated execution requires demonstrated isolation
